description: Relays messages between two Claude Code sessions on different machines using the Channels API
name: io.github.MuhammadTalhaMT/intercom

environmentVariables.description: Label for this instance, e.g. backend or frontend. Appears in message tags so the other side knows who is talking.
environmentVariables.name: MY_ROLE

environmentVariables.description: Address of the other machine as host:port. A Tailscale address is recommended over a public one.
environmentVariables.name: REMOTE_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Shared secret authenticating messages between the two instances. Must match on both sides.
environmentVariables.name: INTERCOM_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Port to listen on for incoming messages. Defaults to 8788.
environmentVariables.name: INTERCOM_PORT

environmentVariables.description: How long an outbound POST may hang before giving up. Defaults to 10000.
environmentVariables.name: INTERCOM_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS
